description: GTFS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by COMPAGNIE AUTOBUS DE MONACO. GTFS flow For more information, visit www.cam.mc or contact the GTFS manager at + 377 97 70 22 03 (direct line). The GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) flow is a standardised computer format, in the form of a ZIP file containing several comma-separated text files, for communicating theoretical timetables and geographical information for public transport. Coverage: Monaco. The publisher named on the listing is COMPAGNIE AUTOBUS DE MONACO. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-08-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
